tools.name: calculate_vat
tools.description:
Calculate EU VAT (Dutch: BTW) for a cross-border or domestic sale, using
the destination-country principle that applies to e-commerce.

Handles the cases sellers get wrong: OSS distance selling to another EU
country, B2B reverse charge when the buyer has a VIES-valid VAT number,
and zero-rated exports outside the EU. Rates are the statutory ones for
the destination country, including reduced rates when a category is given.

customer_country.description: Two-letter country code the goods are shipped to, e.g. NL, DE, FR. This is what determines the rate.

seller_country.description: Two-letter country code the seller is established in. Defaults to NL.

customer_vat_number.description: Buyer VAT number. Required for B2B reverse charge; it is checked against VIES, so an invented number will not zero the VAT.

is_business.description: True when the buyer is a business (B2B). Reverse charge also needs a valid VAT number.

category.description: Optional product category, used to find a reduced rate (books, food, medicine and similar).

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description:
Validate an IBAN (bank account number) and report whether its check
digits and country-specific length are correct.

Catches transposed or missing digits before a payment or an invoice goes
out with the wrong account number. This checks the number's structure,
not whether the account exists or who owns it.

iban.description: The IBAN to check. Spaces, dots and dashes are ignored, so it can be pasted as printed.

tools.name: bol_commission
tools.description:
Work out what bol.com keeps from a sale: the commission percentage for
the product category, any fixed fee, and what the seller is left with.

Category names are the Dutch ones bol.com uses ("Elektronica", "Boeken",
"Speelgoed"). If the category is unknown or missing, the tool returns the
list of categories it knows, so call it again with one of those.

category.description: bol.com main category, in Dutch. For example: Elektronica, Boeken, Speelgoed, Wonen & Koken.

price.description: Selling price in euros, including VAT, as shown to the buyer.

subcategory.description: Subcategory when the main one splits by rate, e.g. Telefoons or Televisies under Elektronica.

fulfilment_type.description: lvb for Logistiek via bol, fbr when the seller ships. Leave out if it does not matter.
